name: Visitor gallery segment
description: One tileable 7.2 m bay of a lit public viewing corridor for a generic chip-fab scene: tiled floor with a darker walkway, solid outer wall with skirting, ceiling panel with a continuous light strip, stainless handrail with posts every 1.8 m, sloped info kiosk with a plain glowing screen, and a wall bench. Long parts end exactly on X = -3.6 (open) and X = +3.6 (single flat cap), so copies placed 7.2 m apart meet plane to plane with no doubled end cap. Glazing is not part of the asset.
brief: Foundry Floor utility kit (interior batch 3), asset 2 of 3: visitor gallery segment, 7.2 x 3.0 x 3.6 m, datum corridor floor, -Z solid exterior wall, +Z toward the (absent) glazing, locators tourCamera and kioskScreen, hideable ceilingPanel/ceilingLight/infoKiosk/bench, 6 materials, no clips.
